candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces show every checkout correlation failing with an upstream 500 from order:8000, and gateway metrics show 16 502s vs 2.7 200s on /v1/checkout in 60s.
candidates.uncertainty: The 500 originates in order, but the underlying order-side fault (db pool, redis, payment latency, config) is not established by current evidence; logs were excluded.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are consistently caused by order returning 500 on POST /v1/orders across all traced correlation IDs; gateway metrics confirm elevated 502 rate on /v1/checkout. The proximate cause is bounded to http-500 at order, but the deeper order-side fault is not yet established, so only the http-500 candidate is offered.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/errors explaining the 500 on POST /v1/orders
Order-side dependency metrics (postgresql pool, redis, payment) to identify the underlying fault
Excluded evidence ev-f430679fd864ea83-r0-gw_logs was not admitted
